_delta: Firefox delta from manifest.json. No background service worker is used, so the only real differences are the gecko id (required for install/signing) and the MV3 floor. Keep the two manifests in sync: any change to content_scripts, action, or permissions must be mirrored here. To try it in Firefox, about:debugging -> This Firefox -> Load Temporary Add-on -> pick this file.
name: Simple YouTube
description: Strips YouTube back down to a video player and a list of videos. No tracking, no telemetry, no network calls.
author: Diskette Labs
